scope: Actual agentctl Native/registry/AgentStore/test.run resident output off/on; scripted model choices

rows.actions: scripted Native-parser choices; real agentctl/tool execution

method.residency: one model process; reset session only between independent tasks; no KV save/evict/restore
method.receipt: both off/on body-first then final status footer; default CLI legacy layout unchanged
method.workload: three real test.run calls plus four real Native prepare/first-greedy/actions through CLI REPL and AgentStore; fixed Native-parser tool choices;8 plain lines; actual words/iterations recorded on every row
method.order: One warmup then seven evaluations per case/mode, rotating modes; sequential unsanitized performance without concurrent owned test/build.
method.metrics: CLI tick wall including tools, transcript assembly, Native and numeric logs; exact post-token independent tokenizer oracle measured separately and subtracted; raw wall retained
method.excluded: model load, helper first/warm execution, per-task ordinary Native reset; no build optimization

allocation_mib.scope: Allocation reservation from init logs, not resident RSS or peak physical usage; both E44 controls share1024 capacity; no isolated capacity/performance comparison.

method.metal_timing: Process-local public Metal method interception; GPU command intervals unioned, CPU-driver scheduling is not shader time; raw timestamps use Mach system base. Scope ends before independent oracle. Bare disables collection only; common wrappers and decode/sync timers remain.
method.notification: E43 -notify only; timestamp-only completion block; delivery and post-marker return are upper bounds with driver/handler/scheduling mixed. Other modes never register this marker.
method.batch_policy: E44: allocated1024 throughout; split cap512 vs bounded coalescing<=1024; streaming budget512 unchanged; strict public drain. E42/E43: allocated512, strict/deferred controls as labeled.

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; real CLI/tool execution, not autonomous model planning or full output generation
Tools bounded retained4096 bytes; test.run(empty args) and verified Qwen3 template only; full render/prefix guard remains
No snapshots, evictions, disk-KV transfer, memory capacity win, cloud SSE or Windows/CUDA acceptance
No evaluation tuning; all warmup/evaluation pairs and negative results retained; per-task reset/model-resident workload only

Metal GPUStart/End is buffer execution span, not pure shader busy time. commit-to-start overlaps preceding own GPU execution; uncovered delay cannot exclusively identify another device queue or competing PID.

GPU end to wait return includes driver notification, pre-existing handlers, CPU scheduling and return overhead. Completion markers perturb this path and are diagnostic only. Bare still has method forwarding and common CPU timers.
E39 original44.039ms pair had no device timestamps; these new observations do not retrospectively assign that exact pair to GPU versus wakeup.
All outliers, probe overhead and negative paired results retained; background system load is uncontrolled; no tail-latency guarantee or physical KV reduction.
E44 split and coalesced controls both allocate batch1024; not an exact512-capacity old baseline. No memory savings claimed; buffer allocation cost recorded in method.
